newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Bangladesh taka closes easier on high dlr demand.
newsitem.headline: Bangladesh taka closes easier on high dlr demand.

text.p: Demand for the U.S. currency for import payment compelled the Bangladesh taka to ease at 43.8200/8300 against the dollar in interbank trading on Tuesday, dealers said. It previously closed at 43.7500/7600.
A dealer with a foreign bank said the local unit weakened as demand for the greenback grew for import payment. "The demand for dollars was high ahead of Wednesday's public holiday," he said.
The call money was traded at 8.0 to 9.0 percent, up from a previous 7.5 to 8.5 percent, dealers said.
